# n8n-nodes-taifoon examples

<!-- generated by examples/flow.mjs from flow.json, the workflows and runs/; edit those, then: node examples/flow.mjs --write -->

Small workflows for the Taifoon node, one per step of the flow. Each one imports into n8n as it is, carries its instructions in a sticky note, and holds a credential placeholder only (never a key). Each was run inside n8n 2.39.8 before it was published: the last run is under every example.

**Import:** n8n → Workflows → Import from File (or paste the JSON). Install the community node `n8n-nodes-taifoon` first. Where a node needs a key, attach a **Taifoon Relayer API** credential (example 1a gets you a free key).

Money and chain writes stay on the Taifoon devnet 36927: test tokens (dUSDC) with no value. Nothing here signs or sends a transaction.

## The flow

### Buyer

Say what you need in words. The layer matches a seller, hires it, grades the reply by code and settles; you verify it against the chain.

| Phase | What happens | Node operation | Call | Example · node | Costs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Key | Get a free key for a wallet label (nothing is signed) and read its tenant. | `account.register` | `POST /v1/register` | [1a-free-key-and-tenant](1a-free-key-and-tenant.json) · Register Free Key | free: 3 keys a day per IP |
| Tenant | Who the saved key belongs to, its keys and the next step. | `account.me` | `GET /v1/tenant/me` | [1b-my-tenant](1b-my-tenant.json) · Get My Tenant | free |
| Demand | Post the need in words. A dry run first shows the class, the input read from the words and the cover preview, and keeps nothing. | `demand.post` | `POST /v1/demands` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Preview the match, Post demand | free on the devnet: the key's own demand budget |
| Match | The auto-match loop (every 2 minutes) claims the demand and ranks the class's sellers by their own record: open → claimed → matched. | `demand.get` | `GET /v1/demands/{id}` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Get demand | free (reads) |
| Handshake | The broker offers the job to the chosen seller in its own protocol and holds the reply: the seller, the ranking and the reply digest. | `handshake.get` | `GET /v1/handshake/{id}` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Get handshake | free (reads) |
| Job | The job is funded on the devnet, the reply is graded by the class's own check (no model), and the job settles: hired → graded → settling → settled. | `demand.get` | `GET /v1/demands/{id}` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Get demand | free: code grades spend no credit; the devnet escrow uses test tokens |
| Attest | Re-derive the settle transaction and the payee from chain before anyone acts on the result: REAL, FABRICATED or UNVERIFIED. | `proof.attestHire` | `POST /v1/attest/hire` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Verify hire claim | free |
| Explorer | The job as the explorer shows it: who did the work, who the chain paid, the grade and every transaction with its link. | `explorer.get` | `GET /v1/explorer/jobs/{id}` | [2-buyer-need-to-verified](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · Explorer | free |

### Seller

List an n8n workflow as a seller, take jobs on its hire webhook, and hand finished work to the relayer.

| Phase | What happens | Node operation | Call | Example · node | Costs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim | Claim the seller workflow by its card URL. The answer carries a nonce for the card field taifoon_listing. | `account.registerSeller` | `POST /v1/listings/claim` | [3-seller-claim-verify-complete](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · Register Seller | free (any key, a free key included) |
| Verify | The layer reads the card for the nonce and sends one class probe to the hire webhook, graded by the class's check. A pass lists the workflow. | `account.verifySeller` | `POST /v1/listings/{id}/verify` | [3-seller-claim-verify-complete](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · Verify Seller | free |
| Jobs | Jobs arrive on the hire webhook when the loop hires the listing; the job feed shows the jobs an address sells, with a cursor. | `job.getChanged` | `GET /v1/jobs` | [3-seller-claim-verify-complete](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · Get open jobs | free (reads) |
| Completion | Hand a finished job to the relayer with its proof transaction. Idempotent on job ID + nonce: a repeat returns the first outcome and never a second transaction. | `completion.submit` | `POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/complete` | [3-seller-claim-verify-complete](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · Submit completion | free (the key's write budget) |
| Status | Poll the completion until it is recorded or settled. | `completion.getStatus` | `GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/complete?nonce=` | [3-seller-claim-verify-complete](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · Completion status | free (the key's read budget) |

### Around the flow

Public reads that need no key: who can do what, what the guarantee costs, and whether a transaction is inside the root.

| Phase | What happens | Node operation | Call | Example · node | Costs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Discover | What n8n templates and nodes can do, the skill vocabulary, the standards deployed, agent cards and the market; then one provider's record. | `discovery.getCapabilities`, `discovery.getCapabilitySkills`, `discovery.getStandards`, `agent.getCards`, `agent.getMarket`, `agent.getReputation` | `GET /v1/agents/who/{address}` | [4-discovery-to-reputation](4-discovery-to-reputation.json) · Capabilities, Skills, Standards, Cards, Market, Reputation | free |
| Assure | Price the guarantee from one seller's settled record and build the unsigned fund-job calls. Nothing is signed or sent. | `assurance.getPools`, `assurance.getQuote`, `assurance.buildCall` | `POST /v1/assurance/call` | [5-assurance-quote-and-plan](5-assurance-quote-and-plan.json) · Pools, Quote, Build call | free: a plan, never a transaction |
| Prove | The latest superroot, then the inclusion proof of one transaction with exactly what was checked. | `proof.getRoot`, `proof.getTxProof` | `GET /v1/proof/tx/{chain}/{tx}` | [6-proof-root-and-tx](6-proof-root-and-tx.json) · Latest root, Transaction proof | free |

### GRID points and credits

- **Earn:** GRID points are earned by bringing a resource the oracle can probe (an RPC endpoint, storage, a GPU) and settle as soulbound GRID every 6 h. Running these workflows earns no GRID. ([GRID](https://www.taifoon.io/grid))
- **Spend:** Settled GRID pays for Jev grades and gateway credit at the USDC price (1 GRID = 0.01 USDC), signed by the wallet that holds it. (`GET https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/judge/credits/grid?wallet=0x…`)
- **In this flow:** Nothing in these examples spends credit: demands settle on the devnet, the grades are code grades, and every read is free. A Jev grade (Judge resource) is the first step that spends: 3 free on a key, then a block of 3 for 0.15 USDC or 15 GRID.

## The examples

### 1a: get a free key and check its tenant

[1a-free-key-and-tenant.json](1a-free-key-and-tenant.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/1a-free-key-and-tenant.json

Registers a free Taifoon key for a wallet label (no credential needed), reads the new tenant with that key, and returns the tenant and key prefixes only. The keys appear once, in the Register Free Key output; successful runs are not saved.

**Operations:** `account.register`

**Credential:** none (public reads)

**Expected output** (`Summary`): `ok=true`, `tenant_id`, `tenant_via=n8n`, `key_prefix`, `keys`

**Last run:** PASS · n8n.taifoon.dev 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 353 · 2026-10-01 07:24 UTC · 24 s

### 2: buyer (a need in words → matched → hired → graded → settled → verified)

[2-buyer-need-to-verified.json](2-buyer-need-to-verified.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/2-buyer-need-to-verified.json

Posts a need in words. The layer maps it to a job class by fixed rules (preview first, kept nothing), matches a seller, opens the handshake, grades the reply by code and settles on the Taifoon devnet 36927 (test tokens, no value). The workflow polls the demand, reads the handshake and the explorer row, and re-derives the settle transaction from chain with Verify Hire Claim before it hands back the result.

**Operations:** `demand.post`, `demand.get`, `handshake.get`, `explorer.get`, `proof.attestHire`

**Credential:** Taifoon Relayer API on Preview the match, Post demand, Get demand, Get handshake

**Expected output** (`Result`): `preview.class`, `preview.input`, `preview.premium`, `demand`, `state=settled`, `seller`, `handshake.id`, `handshake.state`, `grade.verdict`, `job_id`, `settle_tx`, `settle_link`, `doer`, `payee`, `attestation.verdict=REAL`, `explorer`

**Last run:** PASS · local n8n 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 1 · 2026-10-01 07:19 UTC · 4 min 38 s · [settle_link](https://www.taifoon.io/scan/36927/tx/0x97cff95880e21a3f574fe23b16495c3adaee2ee4c3ad660a8db95c318213d3ad) · [explorer](https://www.taifoon.io/scan/jobs/dm_489a9dccea554cbd83fdebec)

### 3: seller (claim a listing → verify → receive jobs → submit completion)

[3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json](3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/3-seller-claim-verify-complete.json

Lists an n8n seller workflow with the layer (claim its card, the card serves the nonce, verify: the layer reads the card and runs one class probe), then polls for jobs where the seller address is the provider and hands a finished job to the relayer (idempotent on job ID + nonce) and reads its status.

**Operations:** `account.registerSeller`, `account.verifySeller`, `job.getChanged`, `completion.submit`, `completion.getStatus`

**Credential:** Taifoon Relayer API on Register Seller, Verify Seller, Submit completion, Completion status

**Expected output** (`Result`): `listing.id`, `listing.state=listed`, `listing.last_probe.ok=true`, `jobs.source=pinned`, `completion.accepted=true`, `completion.replay=true`, `completion.status`, `status.status`

**Last run:** PASS · n8n.taifoon.dev 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 349 · 2026-10-01 07:24 UTC · 29 s

### 4: discovery (capabilities, skills, standards, cards, market → pick a provider → reputation)

[4-discovery-to-reputation.json](4-discovery-to-reputation.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/4-discovery-to-reputation.json

Reads what is out there with public reads only (no credential): what n8n templates and nodes can do, the skill vocabulary, which standards are deployed where, agent cards with an owner and a published skill, the market statistics. Picks a provider from the cards and checks its reputation in the public job log.

**Operations:** `discovery.getCapabilities`, `discovery.getCapabilitySkills`, `discovery.getStandards`, `agent.getCards`, `agent.getMarket`, `agent.getReputation`

**Credential:** none (public reads)

**Expected output** (`Result`): `capabilities.templates`, `capabilities.nodes`, `capabilities.skills_total`, `top_skills`, `standards`, `cards.matching`, `market.observed_jobs`, `provider.address`, `reputation.address`, `reputation.as_provider`

**Last run:** PASS · local n8n 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 2 · 2026-10-01 07:18 UTC · 9 s

### 5: assurance (pools → quote → unsigned fund-job calls; plan only)

[5-assurance-quote-and-plan.json](5-assurance-quote-and-plan.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/5-assurance-quote-and-plan.json

Reads the coverage pools, picks the seller with the longest settled record, prices the guarantee for one job from that record, and builds the unsigned fund-job calls on the Taifoon devnet 36927. Nothing is signed or sent: the output is the calldata, its effect in words and who must sign it.

**Operations:** `assurance.getPools`, `assurance.getQuote`, `assurance.buildCall`

**Credential:** none (public reads)

**Expected output** (`Plan`): `seller`, `record.settled`, `premium.label`, `premium.charged_units`, `terms.rule`, `job_id`, `chain_id=36927`, `calls`, `calls.0.data`, `calls.1.data`, `calls.1.signer`

**Last run:** PASS · local n8n 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 3 · 2026-10-01 07:18 UTC · 9 s

### 6: proof (latest root → transaction proof → output)

[6-proof-root-and-tx.json](6-proof-root-and-tx.json) · raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taifoon-io/n8n-nodes-taifoon/main/examples/6-proof-root-and-tx.json

Reads the latest superroot and how long ago it was anchored, then asks for the inclusion proof of one Base transaction, waiting while the producer is still building that block's proof, and returns exactly what was checked.

**Operations:** `proof.getRoot`, `proof.getTxProof`

**Credential:** none (public reads)

**Expected output** (`Output`): `root.epoch`, `root.root`, `tx`, `block`, `block_hash`, `checks.receipt_found=true`, `checks.tx_succeeded=true`

**Last run:** PASS · local n8n 2.39.8, node 0.6.0 · execution 2 · 2026-10-01 07:23 UTC · 5 s

## How they are tested

Before an example is published it is imported and executed headless inside n8n, and its last node is checked field by field: a null or empty field where data is expected fails it. The record of each last run is in [runs/](runs/). The runs are test-tagged: our own key, buyer labels that start with `ours:`, settlement on the devnet only, no paid call.
